definitions: To take advantage of an opportunity immediately.
To act decisively and without delay when a favorable situation arises.
examples: The job offer is great, you should strike while the iron is hot and accept it.
They decided to strike while the iron is hot and launch their product before competitors did.
If you want to buy that house, you need to strike while the iron is hot because it won't last long.
lemma: strike while the iron is hot
synonyms: make hay while the sun shines
source: strike while the iron is hot
